content: All the works reviewed in sec:introduction ( BIBREF12 , BIBREF13 , BIBREF14 , BIBREF15 , BIBREF16 ) consider GARCH(1,1) benchmark. However, given the long horizon of their predictions (e.g. quarterly or annual), the models are evaluated using the unconditional volatility $\sigma _u$ in eq:unvar. In this work, we focus on the short-term volatility prediction and use the GARCH(1,1) one-day ahead conditional volatility prediction in eq:forecastoneperiod to evaluate our models.
